turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did you give my son a zero without calling me first?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
I'm not here to talk about how I speak. You gave Owen a zero, and he found out from his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and why didn't you call me first?
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
I've asked you twice. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
I'm sorry? Owen's zero. Who decided it?
